note: 1 unit = ¼ of the stock's normal daily range (0.25 × daily ATR). Open trades close by 3:55 PM ET. Both are machine-generated, not tested edges: they win on up days and lose on down days.

setups.title: Morning Momentum Pop
lines: 70%+ of stocks trading above VWAP (broad up morning)
Volatile (daily range ≥ 4.4% of price), ≥ $50M traded a day
RSI(14) jumps 19+ points in 15 min and the 5-min bar has a long lower wick (≥ ⅓ of the bar)
Stop 1 unit below; no target, hold to 3:55 PM

setups.title: Midday Failed-Breakdown Reclaim
lines: Broke below its opening-range low, now back above it; crossed VWAP 4+ times; still ≥ 0.31% below its 20-bar average
Stop 1 unit below; once up 1 unit, trail 1 unit behind; else close 3:55 PM
